title: YNX Bridge — Verify cross-network transfer state
metaDescription: Inspect provider, route, proof, destination confirmation, availability, incident and recovery evidence without confusing progress with completed asset delivery.
features: Separate source finality, proof, destination confirmation and availability
Read-only public status and SDK surface
Fail-closed refund, dispute and correction states
risks: No approved provider currently exposes a verified YNX asset route.
No funded YNX Testnet deposit or withdrawal has been accepted.
Threshold-relayer attestations are not light-client or trustless consensus proofs.

faq.question: Does destination confirmation mean the asset is available?
faq.answer: No. Consumers must require destination_available and destinationAssetAvailable=true.

faq.question: Is a YNX bridge route live?
faq.answer: No approved provider route or funded YNX Testnet transfer is currently verified.
